SELECT ci.id, ci.order_id as orderId, bo.order_no as orderNo, ci.room_id as roomId, r.room_number as roomNumber, rt.type_name as roomTypeName, bo.user_id as userId, u.username as username, ci.guest_name as guestName, ci.guest_phone as guestPhone, ci.check_in_time as checkInTime, ci.check_out_date as checkOutDate, ci.deposit, ci.status, e.real_name as operatorName, ci.create_time as createTime FROM check_in_record ci LEFT JOIN booking_order bo ON ci.order_id = bo.id LEFT JOIN room r ON ci.room_id = r.id LEFT JOIN room_type rt ON r.room_type_id = rt.id LEFT JOIN users u ON bo.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN employee e ON ci.operator_id = e.id
AND r.room_number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{roomNumber}, '%')
AND ci.guest_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{guestName}, '%')
AND ci.guest_phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{phone}, '%')
AND ci.status = #{status}
AND ci.check_in_time >= DATE(#{startDate,jdbcType=DATE})
AND ci.check_in_time < DATE_ADD(DATE(#{endDate,jdbcType=DATE}), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
ORDER BY ci.check_in_time DESC

SELECT ci.id, ci.order_id as orderId, bo.order_no as orderNo, ci.room_id as roomId, r.room_number as roomNumber, rt.type_name as roomTypeName, bo.user_id as userId, u.username as username, ci.guest_name as guestName, ci.guest_phone as guestPhone, ci.guest_id_card as guestIdCard, ci.check_in_time as checkInTime, ci.check_out_date as checkOutDate, ci.deposit, ci.status, ci.operator_id as operatorId, e.real_name as operatorName, ci.remark, ci.create_time as createTime FROM check_in_record ci LEFT JOIN booking_order bo ON ci.order_id = bo.id LEFT JOIN room r ON ci.room_id = r.id LEFT JOIN room_type rt ON r.room_type_id = rt.id LEFT JOIN users u ON bo.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN employee e ON ci.operator_id = e.id WHERE ci.id = #{id}
